summary: A monthly bike night hosted by Mudpuppies Sports Bar and Grill (last Thursday of the month, 4-9pm) with reserved rider parking and food/drink specials. It is a bar promotion open to any local biker who wants to show up, not a named motorcycle club or riding group with a defined membership.
